provider.costRule: The table below is a planning guide measured on 2026-10-04. Before every generation, call openart_model_cost; the live cost wins. Never submit a mode openart_model_list marks unaffordable.

routing.note: No 2:1 option (measured 2026-10-04): generate 16:9 at 2k (2720x1536) and centre-crop to 2:1; the crop keeps the full width.

routing.task: draft image with legible layout or text

routing.note: Text-to-image price. Image-to-image from an existing creation quoted 47 credits at 2K and 33 at 1K on 2026-10-04 (live quote wins); confirm 1K output width before using it for 1280 px placements.

routing.task: shot planning before an expensive video
routing.fallback: none: write the shot list by hand
Nano Banana 2 Lite (15) for illustration only

budget.monthlyEnvelope: set by the CFO General; until set, the producer may not exceed 300 credits per calendar month across briefs
rules: The brief states the budget. No budget, no spend: return a plan with the credits it would need.
Drafts on the cheapest tier that can meet the brief; the quality tier only for the selected direction.
Three first-round directions, one draft each. At most two one-variable refinements on one direction, then stop.
Video only after a still direction is selected, and only when the brief names motion.
Report credits spent and the balance from openart_account_get in every hand-off.

staging.record: asset.json beside the files: job, placement, crop, model, prompt, seed or creation id, credits, rights note, alt intent, rubric scores, lifecycle
staging.rule: Download the generated file into staging; never hotlink a generation URL. Staging is the producer's only write area besides its memory.

roles.worker-visual-producer: intake → candidate (never approves its own work)
roles.worker-visual-qa: candidate → reviewed for UI captures and pages; asset review uses agent-os/rubrics/art-asset.md
roles.general-cco: reviewed → integration-ready for creative and canon
roles.owner: integration-ready → released (publishing, uploads, and spend above the approval line)

releaseBar.ship: no 0s, average at least 2.2, provenance at least 2, asset record complete
releaseBar.characterWork: character-studio stop rules apply: no public release below 88/100, below 7/10 on any dimension, with any hard veto, or without named human approval

never: Generation on a schedule or cron (spend needs judgment)
Uploading local files or references to a provider without the owner's approval
A real person's likeness, a third-party mark, or a copyrighted character
Publishing, posting, or moving files out of staging into a product repository

openQuestions.question: Does the OpenArt Starter plan grant commercial use of Kling 3 Omni output (for example a public repository social preview)?
openQuestions.blocks: release of any OpenArt-generated asset beyond candidate

learned: 2026-10-04 ACOS social preview proof: 3 drafts, 30 credits, one direction cleared the art-asset bar (2.44). Cheapest-tier drafts were enough to pick a direction; the 2:1 crop preview is what the reviewer should judge, not the 16:9 original.
